project.name: Candidate geometric Hamiltonians and prepared-FL dynamics
project.subtitle: Exact K=4, total-spin-zero study (dimension 105). The baseline is complete-graph face-to-face area exchange plus on-site repulsion, with equal hopping strength on each bond. We added the positive RS-volume term and the signed triple-grasp term as separate candidate Hamiltonians, then evolved five explicitly prepared FL references under the baseline and both signed couplings. The 62 parameter settings cover U/t=0,1,5,20 and normalized coupling alpha=-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2; the ring is included only as a sparse-hopping control. The study contains 6,510 saved energy levels and 50 prepared-state trajectories.
